normal_happy_path.rationale: This dimension applies because Exact four-widget catalog oracle is a GUI or GUI-adjacent contract whose authoritative state can be observed across normal happy path. The packet supplies a bounded affirmative rule, so this dimension is certified subject to the stated falsification oracle.
scenarios: Load a canonical fixture for Exact four-widget catalog oracle, invoke its primary user-visible behavior once, and compare the committed state and rendered outcome with the declared contract.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A versioned nominal fixture for Exact four-widget catalog oracle executes from a clean state; exactly one intended transition is committed, the rendered result identifies the effective state, and the emitted record links input, decision, and output.
observables: one accepted transition with a stable correlation identifier
post-state equals the fixture expectation
rendered status and event record name the same effective outcome

oracle.pass: Exactly one intended transition commits and every recorded and rendered value matches the fixture expectation.
oracle.fail: No transition, more than one transition, an unexpected side effect, or any mismatch between committed, rendered, and recorded outcome.

boundary_invalid_input.rationale: This dimension applies because Exact four-widget catalog oracle is a GUI or GUI-adjacent contract whose authoritative state can be observed across boundary and invalid input. The packet supplies a bounded affirmative rule, so this dimension is certified subject to the stated falsification oracle.
scenarios: Run Exact four-widget catalog oracle at each declared minimum and maximum, then submit malformed, unknown, duplicate, overlong, and semantically conflicting values.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: For Exact four-widget catalog oracle, all valid edge values normalize once to the canonical representation; every invalid value is rejected before mutation with a stable field-level reason and no loss of the prior valid state.
observables: canonical normalized value for every accepted boundary case
structured rejection code and location for every invalid case
unchanged authoritative state after each rejection

oracle.pass: Every boundary fixture has the declared canonical value or deterministic rejection and no rejected fixture mutates authority.
oracle.fail: An invalid fixture is accepted, aliases normalize differently, an error lacks a stable location, or rejected input changes authoritative state.

failure_partial_failure.rationale: This dimension applies because Exact four-widget catalog oracle is a GUI or GUI-adjacent contract whose authoritative state can be observed across failure and partial failure. The packet supplies a bounded affirmative rule, so this dimension is certified subject to the stated falsification oracle.
scenarios: Inject a precondition failure, a dependency failure before commit, and a dependency failure after one provisional substep while exercising Exact four-widget catalog oracle.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Exact four-widget catalog oracle distinguishes failed, partially completed, and rolled-back outcomes; it exposes the committed subset, retains a correlation identifier, and supplies a safe recovery action without reporting success early.
observables: failure phase and committed-subset ledger
user-visible state that is not success while work is incomplete
rollback or resumable recovery receipt

oracle.pass: Injected failures yield the exact declared terminal state, identify every committed substep, and either restore the prior state or expose a bounded resumable recovery.
oracle.fail: Failure is shown as success, committed work is hidden, rollback status is ambiguous, or recovery can repeat an already committed side effect.

cancellation_retry_idempotency_stale_rec.rationale: This dimension applies because Exact four-widget catalog oracle is a GUI or GUI-adjacent contract whose authoritative state can be observed across cancellation retry idempotency stale state and recovery. The packet supplies a bounded affirmative rule, so this dimension is certified subject to the stated falsification oracle.
scenarios: Cancel Exact four-widget catalog oracle before mutation and at the last interruptible point, replay the same request identifier, retry after a stale snapshot, and recover after restart.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Exact four-widget catalog oracle defines a cancellation boundary, idempotency key, stale-revision response, retry eligibility, and recovery checkpoint; replay never produces a second committed effect.
observables: cancellation acknowledgement with last safe checkpoint
single commit for repeated idempotency key
stale-revision rejection naming current revision
recovery receipt showing resumed or rolled-back state

oracle.pass: Cancellation stops only at a declared boundary, replay is side-effect free, stale state cannot overwrite newer state, and recovery reaches one declared terminal state.
oracle.fail: Cancellation leaves an untracked mutation, retry duplicates an effect, stale input wins, or recovery cannot determine whether the operation committed.

concurrency_race_ordering.rationale: This dimension applies because Exact four-widget catalog oracle is a GUI or GUI-adjacent contract whose authoritative state can be observed across concurrency race and ordering. The packet supplies a bounded affirmative rule, so this dimension is certified subject to the stated falsification oracle.
scenarios: Issue two conflicting operations for Exact four-widget catalog oracle from separate views at the same base revision while interleaving validation, rendering, and commit order.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Exact four-widget catalog oracle has one authoritative revision and ordering rule; at most one conflicting writer commits, losers receive the winning revision, and all observers converge without transient authority inversion.
observables: monotonic revision or sequence values
one winner and deterministic loser disposition
converged state digest across all observers
trace proving validation and commit were atomic

oracle.pass: The declared ordering selects one valid outcome, conflicting writers cannot both commit, and every observer converges to the same revision and digest.
oracle.fail: Two conflicting commits succeed, revision order regresses, render order changes authority, or observers retain divergent terminal state.

permission_security_privacy_credentials.rationale: This dimension applies because Exact four-widget catalog oracle is a GUI or GUI-adjacent contract whose authoritative state can be observed across permission security privacy and credentials. The packet supplies a bounded affirmative rule, so this dimension is certified subject to the stated falsification oracle.
scenarios: Exercise Exact four-widget catalog oracle as an authorized principal, an unauthorized principal, a principal whose authority is revoked mid-flow, and an input containing secret-like material.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Exact four-widget catalog oracle checks effective authority at commit, defaults to denial, records requested and effective principal, redacts secret material from UI and telemetry, and invalidates revoked capabilities before side effects.
observables: authorization decision and effective principal identifier
denial receipt with zero side effects
redacted UI and trace snapshots
revocation check tied to commit revision

oracle.pass: Only the authorized effective principal commits; denial and revocation produce no protected side effect, and no credential or private payload appears in rendered or recorded evidence.
oracle.fail: Authority is inferred from presentation state, revocation is ignored, a denied request mutates state, or secret/private material appears in UI, logs, or artifacts.

persistence_restart_offline_upgrade_migr.rationale: This dimension applies because Exact four-widget catalog oracle is a GUI or GUI-adjacent contract whose authoritative state can be observed across persistence restart offline upgrade and migration. The packet supplies a bounded affirmative rule, so this dimension is certified subject to the stated falsification oracle.
scenarios: Persist Exact four-widget catalog oracle, restart before and after commit, repeat while offline, then load the prior-version fixture through the supported migration path.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Exact four-widget catalog oracle specifies its durable fields, schema version, migration direction, offline behavior, and restart recovery; round-trip preserves identity and negative constraints without silently inventing defaults.
observables: pre/post restart state digests
schema version and migration receipt
offline state with queued, rejected, or read-only disposition
round-trip identity and constraint comparison

oracle.pass: Restart preserves the declared durable state, offline behavior is explicit, migration is deterministic and lossless for required fields, and unsupported versions fail closed.
oracle.fail: Restart changes identity, offline work is silently discarded or committed without authority, migration loses a required constraint, or an unknown version is accepted ambiguously.

scale_quota_backpressure_observability.rationale: This dimension applies because Exact four-widget catalog oracle is a GUI or GUI-adjacent contract whose authoritative state can be observed across scale quota backpressure and observability. The packet supplies a bounded affirmative rule, so this dimension is certified subject to the stated falsification oracle.
scenarios: Drive Exact four-widget catalog oracle at empty, typical, declared maximum, and one-over-limit cardinality while slowing its downstream consumer and exhausting its quota.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Exact four-widget catalog oracle publishes measurable limits, bounded work and memory, backpressure behavior, quota accounting, and correlated saturation metrics; overload never changes semantic ordering or hides dropped work.
observables: latency, work-count, memory, queue-depth, and rejection metrics
quota debit and remaining-budget receipt
backpressure or load-shed event linked to the request
final semantic digest at each cardinality

oracle.pass: All declared bounds hold, over-limit work is rejected or deferred deterministically, quota is charged once, and metrics account for every accepted, deferred, and rejected item.
oracle.fail: Resources grow without the declared bound, quota is double charged or bypassed, accepted work disappears, or overload changes ordering or produces unobservable loss.

accessibility_i18n_user_comprehension.rationale: This dimension applies because Exact four-widget catalog oracle is a GUI or GUI-adjacent contract whose authoritative state can be observed across accessibility i18n and user comprehension. The packet supplies a bounded affirmative rule, so this dimension is certified subject to the stated falsification oracle.
scenarios: Operate Exact four-widget catalog oracle by keyboard and assistive semantics under 200 percent text scaling, high contrast, reduced motion, long translated strings, plural variants, and right-to-left layout.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Exact four-widget catalog oracle exposes stable role, name, value, state, focus order, error association, and non-color status; translated and bidirectional content reflows without clipping, semantic loss, or changed authority.
observables: accessibility-tree snapshot and keyboard-focus trace
contrast, text-scale, and reduced-motion audit
localized screenshots for long and RTL fixtures
comprehension copy naming state, consequence, and recovery

oracle.pass: All functions remain operable and understandable without pointer, color, animation, or English word order, and accessibility state matches authoritative application state.
oracle.fail: Focus is trapped or lost, semantics omit state or error, translated content clips or reverses meaning, contrast fails the declared bar, or visual state disagrees with assistive output.

cross_component_authority_ownership_inte.rationale: This dimension applies because Exact four-widget catalog oracle is a GUI or GUI-adjacent contract whose authoritative state can be observed across cross-component authority ownership and integration. The packet supplies a bounded affirmative rule, so this dimension is certified subject to the stated falsification oracle.
scenarios: Route Exact four-widget catalog oracle through each declared producer, consumer, renderer, persistence adapter, and external handoff while injecting one stale or conflicting downstream response.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Exact four-widget catalog oracle names one authoritative owner, versioned producer/consumer payloads, reconciliation precedence, and handoff acknowledgment; adapters may project but cannot silently broaden authority or identity.
observables: owner and consumer identifiers in the trace
versioned handoff payload and acknowledgment
projection-to-authority reconciliation record
same canonical identity across renderer, store, and external boundary

oracle.pass: Every handoff preserves canonical identity and constraints, the declared owner resolves conflicts, and all consumers converge or fail closed with an actionable incompatibility.
oracle.fail: Two components claim authority, an adapter changes identity or constraints, incompatible payloads are silently accepted, or a stale consumer overwrites the owner.
